children: in the U.S. with a full suite of financial products to help customers manage their daily banking.
Deposits will be held at Nu's partner, Lead Bank.
Additionally, the largest digital bank in Latin America has introduced Nu Global, a multi-currency digital account that allows fee-free, fast money movement across over 35 countries.
The products are available beginning today.
The two launches mark Nu's evolution from a Latin American business to a global digital banking platform.
